mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, category_name, price, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_category WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, session_id, category_name, price, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_category WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY price ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_category ( session_id, category_name, price, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{categoryName}, #{price}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_category SET category_name = #{categoryName}, price = #{price}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ticket_category SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.title AS show_title, ps.start_time AS session_start_time, tc.category_name AS ticket_category_name, tc.price AS ticket_price FROM show_info s JOIN performance_session ps ON ps.show_id = s.id JOIN ticket_category tc ON tc.session_id = ps.id WHERE s.id = #{showId} AND ps.id = #{sessionId} AND tc.id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ps.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND tc.status = 'PUBLISHED'
